title: STRIDE: Reasoning-Aware Training for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2605.08625v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) excel at numerical forecasting but operate as black boxes lacking qualitative reasoning. Conversely, applying LLMs directly to temporal data introduces a modality gap: text tokenizers fragment continuous numerical values, degrading mathematical relationships and exploding sequence lengths, leading to computational overhead. To resolve this, we introduce STRIDE (Strategic Time-series Reasoning Injected via Distilled Embeddings), a novel framework natively integrating LLM reasoning into the continuous embedding space of TSFMs. Instead of discrete tokens, STRIDE distills reasoning traces into a lightweight LLM and dynamically projects its pooled hidden states as a continuous cross-modal prior into the numerical encoder. Jointly optimized via cross-entropy and quantile losses, STRIDE readily attaches to diverse architectures (e.g., Chronos-2, Timer-S1). STRIDE ranks #1 on the GIFT-Eval leaderbo

translated_title: STRIDE：面向时间序列预测的推理感知训练
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型在数值预测方面表现出色，但作为黑盒运行，缺乏定性推理能力。相反，直接将大语言模型（LLM）应用于时间数据会引入模态鸿沟：文本分词器会碎片化连续数值，破坏数学关系并导致序列长度爆炸，从而带来计算开销。为解决这一问题，我们提出了STRIDE（Strategic Time-series Reasoning Injected via Distilled Embeddings，通过蒸馏嵌入注入的战略性时间序列推理），这是一个将LLM推理原生集成到TSFM连续嵌入空间的新颖框架。STRIDE不使用离散token，而是将推理轨迹蒸馏到一个轻量级LLM中，并将其池化后的隐状态动态投影为连续的跨模态先验，注入数值编码器。通过交叉熵和分位数损失进行联合优化，STRIDE可以轻松适配多种架构（如Chronos-2、Timer-S1）。STRIDE在GIFT-Eval排行榜上排名第一。
tldr: STRIDE提出了一种新框架，将蒸馏后的LLM推理以连续跨模态先验的形式原生注入时间序列基础模型的嵌入空间，在保持数值预测能力的同时引入推理能力，并登上GIFT-Eval排行榜第一。
en_tdlr: STRIDE is a novel framework that natively injects distilled LLM reasoning into the continuous embedding space of time series foundation models as a cross-modal prior, achieving the #1 rank on the GIFT-Eval leaderboard.
